speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: Look at the colors in this one, Mara.
text_mariner: See the hues in this one, Mara.
text_highland: Look at the colors in this wee one, Mara.

speaker: Mara Voss
text_standard: It's beautiful. Do you think it came from far away?
text_mariner: Aye, 'tis fair. Think it drifted from the deep?
text_highland: It's bonnie. D'ye think it came frae far away?

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: Everything washes up here eventually.
text_mariner: The tide brings all things home, soon or late.
text_highland: Everything washes up here in the end.

speaker: Nessa
text_standard: The water feels strange today, Elena.
text_mariner: The sea's got a queer temper today, Elena.
text_highland: The water feels strange today, Elena.

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: It's just the changing season.
text_mariner: Just the winds turning, Nessa.
text_highland: It's just the changing season, och.

speaker: Mara Voss
text_standard: Mom, help!
text_mariner: Ma, help!
text_highland: Ma, help!

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: I've got you! Never go near the edge again!
text_mariner: I've got ye! Keep clear of the drop!
text_highland: I've got ye! Dinnae go near the edge again!

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: The paths are crumbling, Petra. Someone is going to get hurt.
text_mariner: The cliff paths are rotting, Petra. Sombody's bound to fall.
text_highland: The paths are crumbling, Petra. Someone'll get hurt.

speaker: Petra Mallow
text_standard: Some paths are meant to be forgotten, Elena.
text_mariner: Some roads are best left to the sea, Elena.
text_highland: Some paths are meant to be forgotten in the glen, Elena.

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: Not when my daughter's life is at risk.
text_mariner: Not when my girl's life is on the line.
text_highland: Not when my wee bairn's life is at risk.

speaker: Kade Finn
text_standard: You tie knots like a blind seagull, Mara.
text_mariner: Ye tie knots like a blind gull, Mara.
text_highland: Ye tie knots like a blind seagull, Mara.

speaker: Mara Voss
text_standard: At least I catch more fish than you do.
text_mariner: Least I haul more fish than ye do.
text_highland: At least I catch more fish than you, och.

speaker: Kade Finn
text_standard: Ouch. That hurts.
text_mariner: Aye. That stings.
text_highland: Och. That hurts.

speaker: Dorian Salt
text_standard: You shouldn't be here, Elena. The light only guides ships away.
text_mariner: Ye shouldn't be here, Elena. The beacon only warns folks off.
text_highland: Ye shouldn't be here, Elena. The light only guides ships away.

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: You've been watching us for years. Why?
text_mariner: Ye've kept eyes on us for years. Why?
text_highland: Ye've been watchin' us for years. Why?

speaker: Dorian Salt
text_standard: Some ties can't be severed, no matter how deep the water gets.
text_mariner: Some knots can't be untied, no matter how deep the tide pulls.
text_highland: Some ties cannae be severed, no matter how deep the water gets.

speaker: Nessa
text_standard: The Watcher is real, Kade. I've seen the shadow.
text_mariner: The Watcher ain't no myth, Kade. I seen the shade meself.
text_highland: The Watcher is real, Kade. I've seen the shadow.

speaker: Kade Finn
text_standard: It's just stories to keep children in bed.
text_mariner: Just tales to keep the little ones asleep.
text_highland: It's just stories to keep the bairns in bed.

speaker: Mara Voss
text_standard: What is this place?
text_mariner: What is this place?
text_highland: What is this place?

speaker: Mara Voss
text_standard: These journals... they have my mother's name.
text_mariner: These books... they hold my ma's name.
text_highland: These journals... they have my mither's name.

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: Mara, put those down! You shouldn't know about this.
text_mariner: Mara, drop 'em! 'Tis none of your concern.
text_highland: Mara, put those down! Ye shouldn't know about this.

speaker: Mara Voss
text_standard: Know about what? That Dorian Salt is your father?
text_mariner: Know what? That Dorian Salt is your own blood?
text_highland: Know about what? That Dorian Salt is yer father?

speaker: Dorian Salt
text_standard: I never wanted to cause you pain.
text_mariner: I never meant to bring ye sorrow.
text_highland: I never wanted to cause ye pain.

speaker: Petra Mallow
text_standard: The storm is coming. We must stand together.
text_mariner: The squall is on us. We hold fast together.
text_highland: The storm is comin'. We must stand together.

speaker: Nessa
text_standard: Not while lies poison our soil.
text_mariner: Not while falsehoods rot our shores.
text_highland: Not while lies poison our soil.

speaker: Dorian Salt
text_standard: Tell them the truth, Petra! The child was never lost.
text_mariner: Give 'em the truth, Petra! The babe was never taken by the sea.
text_highland: Tell 'em the truth, Petra! The wee bairn was never lost.

speaker: Petra Mallow
text_standard: I did what I had to do to protect this village!
text_mariner: I did what was needed to keep this town safe!
text_highland: I did what I had to do to protect the village, och!

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: You stole a life.
text_mariner: Ye robbed a soul of its life.
text_highland: Ye stole a life.

speaker: Mara Voss
text_standard: What happens now?
text_mariner: What comes now?
text_highland: What happens now?

speaker: Elena Voss
text_standard: We start over. The truth is finally out.
text_mariner: We start anew. The truth is finally washed ashore.
text_highland: We start over. The truth is finally oot.
